mapper.select: SELECT file_id, management_code, file_name, file_size, created_by, created_department, created_at FROM project_attachments WHERE management_code = #{managementCode} ORDER BY file_id ASC
SELECT file_id, management_code, file_name, file_data, file_size, created_by, created_department, created_at FROM project_attachments WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_attachments (management_code, file_name, file_data, file_size, created_by, created_department, created_at) VALUES (#{managementCode}, #{fileName}, #{fileData}, #{fileSize}, #{createdBy}, #{createdDepartment}, #{createdAt})
